macros.name: notenumberformat
macros.doc: You can use \renewcommand to change \notenumberformat, which formats the note number.

macros.name: noteskip
macros.doc: The length \noteskip is the space between the note number and the start of the note text.

macros.name: theendnotes
macros.doc: Place the command \theendnotes where you want the notes to appear: after the last footnote, usually right before the bibliography.
